mathematical_engine: borrower-level liquidation-distance distribution -> latent forced-sale inventory -> realized liquidation flow
mechanism_statement: Leveraged Aave borrowers near the liquidation boundary are the constrained participants. When collateral/debt state crosses protocol liquidation eligibility, permissionless liquidators are paid a bonus to repay debt and seize collateral, creating forced flow that must be absorbed by the market.
expected_sign_or_payoff_shape: Higher prospectively measured liquidation overhang should precede higher realized Aave liquidation notional; any later market-price sign is separately authorization-gated and not frozen here.
failure_mode: Borrowers may self-deleverage before liquidation, correlated collateral/debt and eMode can invalidate naive shock math, oracle mechanics may dominate, and historical user-state reconstruction may be incomplete or too costly.
regime_dependency: Expected to matter most during leverage build-up and adverse collateral-price shocks; mechanism validation must not be rescued by post-outcome regime selection.

source_authority.canonical_source: Ethereum mainnet Aave V3 official contracts/events; SQD ethereum-mainnet is the initial historical transport for source census only.
source_authority.point_in_time_requirement: All borrower/reserve/oracle state used later must be reconstructible using data available at or before each snapshot block. No present-day state substitution.
source_authority.coverage_gate: First prove protected-safe 2023-2024 event/participant enumeration and provenance; then separately prove borrower-state reconstruction coverage before any overhang or outcome is calculated.

execution_assumptions.cost_model: NOT_APPLICABLE at source census/mechanism-validation stage; any later directional execution layer must freeze costs prospectively.

validation_path: M0 source census -> M1 borrower-state reconstruction gate -> mechanism validation (overhang -> future canonical liquidation notional) -> only then separate executable-market study if promoted.
promotion_policy_reference: AAVE-LIQUIDATION-OVERHANG-001 prospective protocol to be frozen only after source reconstruction feasibility is proven; no market-edge promotion from source or mechanism evidence alone.
material_difference_from_existing_work: Uses borrower-level latent liquidation inventory observable before forced flow, rather than USDC borrow-rate changes or realized liquidation events.
expected_correlation_bucket: DeFi leverage/forced-flow stress; conceptual only before standalone eligibility.
